exclusions.name: Other bakery staff or volunteers
exclusions.why_safe: The evidence specifies that only Sara Copperwheat staffs the stand, Tomas Ilic runs the oven, and Jo Fenwick drives the van. No other actors are mentioned as involved in production or delivery. Excluding others is safe because the evidence package is complete and does not indicate any additional personnel.

exclusions.name: Other vehicles or delivery methods
exclusions.why_safe: The evidence states that no bakery vehicle other than the two scheduled morning runs is due at the green before 3:00 PM. Excluding other vehicles is safe because the deadline is noon, so only the two morning runs are relevant.

exclusions.name: Overnight storage at the stand
exclusions.why_safe: Festival rules prohibit overnight storage, so the stand starts with no stock. Excluding this possibility is safe because it is explicitly forbidden.

exclusions.name: Loaves from other sources (e.g., other bakeries)
exclusions.why_safe: The evidence only mentions Copperwheat Bakery supplying its own stand. There is no indication of any other source. Excluding other sources is safe because the question is specifically about Copperwheat Bakery's delivery.

uncertainties.meaning: The exact number of loaves baked between 5:00 AM and 10:00 AM is uncertain because the oven rate of 30 per hour is a measured average, not a guaranteed constant. Also, the start time of baking relative to the 5:00 AM schedule is not specified; if the oven is not running exactly at 5:00 AM, the total baked could be less than 150.

The number of loaves that have cooled for at least 60 minutes by the 8:00 AM van departure is uncertain because it depends on when baking started and the exact timing of each batch. Loaves baked after 7:00 AM would not be ready by 8:00 AM.

The number of loaves that have cooled for at least 60 minutes by the 11:00 AM van departure is uncertain because it depends on the baking schedule and the 60-minute cooling requirement. Loaves baked after 10:00 AM would not be ready by 11:00 AM.

The exact number of loaves loaded onto the first van run is uncertain because it depends on how many cooled loaves are available at 8:00 AM, and whether that number exceeds the van capacity of 90. If more than 90 are available, only 90 are loaded; if fewer, all are loaded.

The exact number of loaves loaded onto the second van run is uncertain because it depends on how many cooled loaves are available at 11:00 AM, including any leftover from the first run (if the first run did not take all available loaves) and any newly cooled loaves from baking after 8:00 AM.
The exact arrival time of the first van run is uncertain because the 15-minute drive time is an estimate; traffic or other delays could affect it. However, it is expected to arrive around 8:25 AM.
The exact arrival time of the second van run is uncertain because the 15-minute drive time is an estimate; it is expected to arrive around 11:25 AM.
